description: Lock list of HTTP prefixes that are intentionally mounted on `src/app.js` directly (i.e. NOT on `v1Router`). Every (METHOD, path) registered on the live Express app whose `mountOrigin` is `src/app.js` must match one of these prefixes (or one of the universal root probes `/` and `/health`). Adding a new prefix requires lowering the cap in a follow-up PR or providing an ADR — `governance:ci` will fail until both sides agree.

policy.addingNewPrefix: Adding a prefix requires (a) a sentence below in `migrationNotes` explaining why it cannot live on `v1Router`, AND (b) an ADR documenting a sunset date OR an explicit decision that it remains permanently. Do NOT silently expand the list.
policy.removingExistingPrefix: Removing a prefix is good — Phase B planned this. Remove the entry once the route is fully folded into `v1Router` or deleted.

migrationNotes./api/v1/ai/forecasts/refresh: Heavy long-running operation; intentionally mounted with a different timeout middleware than the rest of /api/v1/ai/*.
migrationNotes./api/v1/ai/feature-store/park-snapshots/: Same as above — body-parser limits differ from the v1Router default.
migrationNotes./api/v1/integrations/installed-adapters/: QW7-deprecated alongside `/integrations/adapters/install-local`. Phase B will fold one of them; until then the dual mount is locked by `route-duplicates-baseline.json`.
migrationNotes./api/v1/integrations/installed-adapters: Mounted on `app` because it shares a multer instance with install-local. Phase B will normalize.
migrationNotes./api/v1/master-data: MDM router has its own RBAC + tenant-context middleware stack; folding into v1Router is a Phase D / Phase F task.
migrationNotes./api/v1/staff: Pre-MDM routes; will fold into MDM `/master-data/staff` in Phase D.
migrationNotes./api/v1/adapters: Mounted before the body-parser tweaks for /integrations to keep file-upload semantics simple. Phase B will revisit.
